generation: v4 (fourth generation of the Jev-Style decision series)
architecture: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (24 language layers: 18 Gated DeltaNet + 6 full attention, hidden 2048, tied embeddings; the Qwen3.5 vision tower, frozen; 2,213,241,664 parameters = language 1,881,825,088 + vision 331,416,576; no multi-token-prediction head)
attention: block-causal in the 6 full-attention layers: the input is cut into [start, stop) blocks of at most block_size tokens (state blocks; one short question block, or catalogue blocks + rubric blocks when question + options + slots exceed block_size); every block attends to all earlier tokens and to itself with no causal mask inside the block. Gated-DeltaNet layers are ordinary recurrent layers.

source.checkpoint: uniform average of the final weights of two full fine-tunes of Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B (seeds 0 and 1), exported as a multimodal Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (bf16, 3 safetensors shards)

selection.rule: lowest component-macro NLL on the SAME fixed dev sample (v3 rule)

calibration.fitted_on: 3,325 held-out calibration rows (not training, not dev rows)

weights.model-00001-of-00003.safetensors: bfloat16 (multimodal export of the averaged checkpoint, shard 1 of 3)
weights.model-00002-of-00003.safetensors: bfloat16 (multimodal export of the averaged checkpoint, shard 2 of 3)
weights.model-00003-of-00003.safetensors: bfloat16 (multimodal export of the averaged checkpoint, shard 3 of 3)

runtime.reference_code: src/macjev/ (the scorer the model was trained, calibrated and evaluated with)

dtypes.bfloat16: cuda only (bf16 autocast; the Decision Index run)

runtime.fast_path: CUDA default (fast=None): text-only calls with two or more questions compute the state once (block attention, cached) and score every question's blocks on that cache, batched (src/macjev/runtime/fast_text.py); calls with images or one question use the reference scorer; off on MPS and CPU
runtime.cuda_graphs: default on CUDA in bfloat16 (cuda_graphs=None; True also in float32; CLI --cuda-graphs auto|on|off): 24 CUDA graphs, one per padded row length (64 to 8,192 tokens), recorded when the model loads (67 s on a fresh A100 VM in bfloat16 while Triton compiles the kernels, 8 s once they are cached), replay the whole forward of a text row (state + one question) with one launch; single-question text calls take them, and text calls with several questions while their replays cost less than the fast path (sum over the rows of max(1, padded length / 320) <= 15, in units of a 64-token replay), otherwise the fast path; image calls the reference scorer (src/macjev/runtime/cuda_graphs.py); off on MPS and CPU; in float32 the forward is compute-bound and the graphs gain little
runtime.gated_deltanet: transformers Qwen3.5 layers (flash-linear-attention kernels when installed, otherwise the transformers torch fallback)

compat.category: accepted (keyword) and ignored: temperatures are per question type
compat.head_max: accepted and ignored: no separate question/options cap (32,768-token total budget)

release_runtime_vs_reference.what: jev_style_decision.py vs macjev.train.evaluate.score_rows on the same rows (scripts/check_release_runtime.py; own held-out dev/cal rows incl. image rows)

fast_path_vs_reference_cuda_float32.what: 60 Decision Index 0.3 public requests (605 questions), A100, float32

cuda_graphs_vs_reference.what: graph replay vs macjev.train.evaluate.score_rows on the same rendered rows (scripts/colab/check_cuda_graphs.py; own held-out dev/cal text rows; one A100)
cuda_graphs_vs_reference.gate: pre-declared: top-1 agreement >= 0.995 (bf16) / >= 0.999 with max |dp| <= 0.005 (float32) on these rows, and >= 0.995 vs the bf16 reference on the Decision Index sample below

decision_index_sample.what: 2,000-request stratified sample of the Decision Index 0.3 public suite, the kit's own runner, one A100 (agreement = same top option)

bfloat16_vs_float32.what: reference scorer, bf16 autocast vs float32

bfloat16_fast_vs_bfloat16.what: fast path vs reference scorer, both bf16

bfloat16_fast_vs_float32.what: fast path bf16 vs reference float32

bfloat16_graphs_vs_bfloat16.what: CUDA graphs (fast path for larger calls) vs reference scorer, both bf16

bfloat16_graphs_vs_bfloat16_fast.what: CUDA graphs vs fast path, both bf16

bfloat16_graphs_vs_float32.what: CUDA graphs bf16 vs reference float32

decision_index_sample.gate: top-1 agreement >= 0.995 before a precision / path is used for a full run (pre-declared)

latency_a100.what: 750 Decision Index 0.3 public requests sampled uniformly (seed 20261027), one process, one request at a time, nothing else on the GPU, A100 80GB, bfloat16, this folder's code only; in-process request wall time in ms, model loading excluded

training.hardware: one NVIDIA A100 80GB per run (Google Colab)
training.precision: bf16 full fine-tuning of every language-model weight; vision tower frozen
training.labels: benchmark train splits, generators and teacher-written rows, plus soft labels distilled from TypeSafe Jev 1.14 via its public API for part of the rows
training.decision_index_hygiene: de-duplicated against the public Decision Index 0.3 suite (row hashes, 8-gram and MinHash gates); no suite rows and no suite build scripts were used
